svg.title: To see this, write its diagonal film as 1 2(W(p) + W(−p) −V (p)/2). The stationary tax row has zero jets below order two. Its mixed carrier row has zero jets below order one, by the stationary graph identity. Hence each summand of W, a product of these two rows, vanishes to order at least three. Every summand of V contains two tax rows and vanishes to order at least four. These films are analytic on the common strip, so their external degree-two coefficient is zero. Linearity proves (DP5).
